description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 (23/55022)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals without wills. It involves land parcels, cadastral maps, and registration procedures under the Registration of Title Act, making it clearly a land-related matter that falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
